semanticChecks.method: Self-review of every Indonesian and Tagalog field directly against its canonical Japanese source; no peer translation was read.
semanticChecks.fullText: All paragraphs, prompts, titles, terms, report examples, and illustration alternatives translated in full.
semanticChecks.negation: Retained distinctions between availability of equipment and confirmation of suitability; preserved statements that examples do not specify procedures, force, arrangement, or approval.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndUncertainty: Retained model-dependent suitability, may-change statements, missing-document statuses, and the inability to infer overall validity from one component.
semanticChecks.technicalDistinctions: Kept operating force separate from load weight/speed; lift height and stroke separate from capacity; hand/load chains separate; fall-arrest system components separate; through-rope versus drum storage separate; lifting versus sustained holding separate; axial thrust and rotation separate; displacement, force, measurements, and structural approval separate.
semanticChecks.namesAndNumbers: Preserved Kito, Lever Block trademark relationship, chain block, lever hoist, Tirfor, and kirin jack terminology. No technical quantities added.
semanticChecks.addedInstructions: No safety instructions or procedural details were added.

limitations: Self-review is not independent native-speaker review. Technical loanwords remain where they are more precise than a generic local term.
